resources.string: Your voice matters. Your safety matters.
Report GBV or sexual harassment safely and confidentially. Every report is reviewed by trained officials.
In immediate danger? Tap here for emergency contacts.
You can submit a report without revealing your identity. A tracking token lets you follow up later.
LifeGuard is Uganda\'s national digital platform for Gender-Based Violence (GBV) and sexual harassment prevention, confidential incident reporting, wearable SOS dispatch, and AI counseling support.
Anonymous reporting removes all personal identifiers (name, email, phone) from the submission. You receive a secret tracking token (e.g., TOKEN-LG-123456) to check status without signing in.
LifeGuard complies with the Data Protection and Privacy Act of Uganda. All data is end-to-end encrypted. User location data is shared only during active SOS broadcasts with authorized responders.
By using LifeGuard, you agree to report genuine emergencies and incidents responsibly. Misuse of emergency alert services is prohibited under Ugandan cyber laws.
